title_zh: 核对模拟庭审证词与裁决的区别

scenario.label_zh: 核对模拟庭审证词与裁决的区别
scenario.goal_zh: 核对证人回答在记录中的范围并约定删除把证词写成裁决的句子

context_zh: 两名学生核对完全虚构的模拟庭审作业。此处只练习证据表述，不提供法律建议。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Did the witness testify that she saw the driver?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: No. Look at the transcript: she said she saw a blue car, but couldn't see who was inside.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: I've written that her testimony identified the driver. That goes too far.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: It does. We can say she described the car.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: And this final sentence calls that a verdict, although our mock jury hasn't decided anything.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Let's delete it. We'll keep the witness's account separate from any later decision.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Yes. I'll remove that final sentence and change the earlier line to say she described the car.
